create_TwoWayTransformer: create a TwoWayTransformer that attends to image embeddings using point queries with configurable depth and attention heads
build_TwoWayAttentionBlock: build a TwoWayAttentionBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and MLP layers for sparse token-image interaction
create_Attention: create an Attention layer with downsampled internal dimensions and optional flash attention 3 support
create_RoPEAttention: create a RoPEAttention layer with rotary position encoding applied to queries and keys before scaled dot-product attention
run_TwoWayTransformer_forward: run the TwoWayTransformer forward pass to process point embeddings against image embeddings and return attended representations
